skills.name: openai-adobe-batch-edit-photos
skills.description: Apply consistent photo adjustments across a set of images so they look like they were edited together. Outputs direct final image URLs plus an in-chat preview grid and optional Firefly Board link. Access: 🔐 Signed-In required | Gen AI: ❌

skills.name: openai-adobe-create-mockups

skills.name: openai-adobe-design-from-template

Access: 🔐 Signed-In required | Gen AI: ❌ by default — image replacement only where the surface permits generative AI (e.g. Codex); none on Claude

skills.name: openai-adobe-edit-quick-cut
